summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Sonu Textiles website covering all 7 requirements with frontend pages, backend Motoko actor, language context, and visual theming. Nearly all acceptance criteria are met. One minor gap exists: the backend has no dedicated appointments or orders table — both are stored via the contact message function — which technically satisfies storage but may not be considered a proper separate store. The language toggle persists via sessionStorage as required. All sections respond to the toggle. Visual theme uses deep crimson, gold, and ivory. No significant hallucinated features were found beyond minor additions like a 'Why Choose Us' section and business hours display, which are reasonable enhancements aligned with the brief.

missing_requirements.requirement: Submitted appointment bookings are stored in the backend in a dedicated/distinguishable way
missing_requirements.reason: The backend (main.mo) has no separate appointments table. useSubmitAppointment in useQueries.ts calls submitContactMessage with the appointment details embedded in the message string — appointments are not stored as a distinct type or table in the backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Order submission stores the order in the backend as a distinct order record
missing_requirements.reason: useSubmitOrder in useQueries.ts submits orders via submitContactMessage with order details in the message string. There is no dedicated orders table or order type in the backend, so orders are not stored as first-class records.

hallucinated_features.description: Business hours display in the Contact page sidebar
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention displaying business hours, but the Contact page includes a Clock icon and hours information not specified in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: 'Why Choose Us' section on the homepage with quality, tradition, service, and price pillars
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not specify a 'Why Choose Us' section on the homepage. This is an additional section not requested.
